(7) A high-quality graphic montage displays the One UI 7 interface with various widgets (clock, weather, health stats) and smooth animations. (8) The man stands in the office setting, holding the foldable phone and speaking directly to the camera with enthusiastic hand gestures.

It demonstrates practical use cases—managing a busy schedule and organizing dinner plans—to highlight the efficiency gains for users. It concludes by announcing the One UI 7 rollout for broader device compatibility.
